import { ArrowRight, Check, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

ui-button.description: Reusable Button component for user actions. Supports various visual styles, sizes, and states (loading, disabled). Automatically applies accessible contrast and hover effects based on the theme.

reactDocgen.description:
Reusable Button component for user actions.

Supports various visual styles, sizes, and states (loading, disabled).
Automatically applies accessible contrast and hover effects based on the theme.

variant.description: The visual style variant of the button.

size.description: The size of the button, controlling padding and text size.

isLoading.description: If true, shows a loading spinner and disables the button.

leftIcon.description: Optional icon to display before the text.

rightIcon.description: Optional icon to display after the text.

isSelected.description: Used primarily for 'category' variant to show active state.

children.description: The text content of the button.
